releaseNotes:
Lyric synchronization rebuilt: several timed sources race per song and the best-matching timeline wins, driven by a new frame-accurate playback clock that follows the sound.
New source sheet with confidence, word-timed and background-vocal lyrics, provider preference and finer timing correction.
Volume slider, sleep-timer countdown, signal-path details, Smart Mix Studio, Genre & Language Explorer, Taste DNA, playlist insights and Smart Shuffle.
